frequency: b=sqrt(mu)>0; physical mu=m/(2pi), m positive integer. All identities and gauge certificates hold for every b>0, hence for every permitted m.
rank_argument: For the LRS compact Nil background the only global KID is central Z, which has central index zero. Closure makes a null vector of an individual block constraint adjoint a genuine smooth KID. There is none in m!=0, so each complete block has full row rank. This extends the rank count to all L>=2; symbolic matrices below explicitly check L=-2,-1,0,1,2.
scope: Linear gauge reduction and necessary central KID condition. Real pairs include the conjugate negative central sector, and must be multiplied by abs(m) for the lattice multiplicity.
